home.heroTitle: We build the fastest bikes in the world.
home.whoAreWeText:
We are a Student Team from Politecnico di Torino, born in 2009.

We design and build high-performance recumbent bicycles and compete in international races, pushing the limits of human-powered vehicles.

Learn more at our Team page ↗.

team.title: The Team
team.description:
Policumbent is a Student Team from Politecnico di Torino, Turin, Italy. Founded in 2009 with the aim of designing the fastest human-powered vehicles in the world, the Team has been pushing the limits of speed on land for over a decade.

The Team holds the World Speed Record for the "arm-powered" category with their vehicle "Cerberus," with 83.28 km/h. In the "leg-powered" category, Policumbent holds the Italian men record (136.49 km/h) and the Italian women record (123.88 km/h).

prototypes.title: Our Prototypes
prototypes.description: Our bicycles are among the fastest and most efficient human-powered vehicles in the world. However, beyond the appealing world of competitions and records, the aim of Team Policumbent is to underline the importance of cycling as a real opportunity of creating a new perspective of living a territory, to travel on it and, of course, to respect it.

partners.description: We are proud to collaborate with leading companies and institutions that support our mission to push the limits of human-powered speed. Their contribution is essential to the success of Policumbent.
